observation: The image shows increased opacity or volume loss in the right upper lobe (anterior/superior) and right lower lobe (posterior/inferior). Additionally, there is a retrosternal clear space, which is an area behind the sternum that appears less dense or more transparent on the X-ray. Lastly, there is posterior basal density, which refers to an area of increased density in the lower part of the lung, near the back.
